title: Lost Dogs Here Walk Home As PEOPLE 🐾
description:
In our town, a lost dog walks home as a person, and calling its name turns it back. So nobody says it until the dog is home.

The Dales lost their beagle, Pepper, on Tuesday. Today was the day he'd walk home. I sat on their porch step all day and helped them watch the street.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: When did Mr. Dale know: the doorbell, the vacuum, or the sausage?
